sources.title: Democratic Republic of the Congo MFA: biometric ordinary passport service
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs, International Cooperation, Francophonie and Congolese Diaspora, Democratic Republic of the Congo
sources.officialityEvidence: The current DRC Ministry of Foreign Affairs service page identifies its biometric ordinary-passport service and the Ministry or its missions as the competent issuing services.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Toute personne de nationalité congolaise a le droit de solliciter un passeport ordinaire.

sources.title: Cuba Travel: Regulations for travelling to Cuba
sources.officialityEvidence: Cuba's official tourism portal states the national tourist-entry rule, names the visa-exempt Chinese-national exception and directs tourist applicants to eVisaCuba.
sources.supportingExcerpt: The tourist visa is mandatory to enter Cuba if you do not have Cuban residency. ... Tourist visas via internet ... evisacuba.cu.

sources.title: Côte d'Ivoire Ministry of Foreign Affairs: advice for travellers
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs, African Integration and the Diaspora, Côte d'Ivoire
sources.officialityEvidence: The current Côte d'Ivoire MFA traveller guidance sets the visitor document baseline and directs visitors to the SNEDAI visa route or a conditional airport-visa route.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Passeport valide plus de 6 mois et visa requis (demande en ligne via le portail officiel de Snedai ou visa aéroportuaire sous conditions).

sources.title: Côte d'Ivoire official SNEDAI: e-visa procedure
sources.publisher: SNEDAI, official Côte d'Ivoire visa service
sources.officialityEvidence: SNEDAI identifies itself as Côte d'Ivoire's only State-approved visa-application website, limits the online process to valid ordinary-passport holders, and states that the visa is printed and issued at the airport after approval.
sources.supportingExcerpt: La demande en ligne du E-visa est valable uniquement pour les détenteurs de passeports ordinaires.

sources.title: Nigeria Immigration Service: 2026 Tourism (F5A) visa service level
sources.officialityEvidence: Nigeria Immigration Service's April 2026 service-level document defines F5A tourism eligibility for citizens of all countries, its online process, and delivery of a visa certificate by email.
sources.supportingExcerpt: F5A- TOURISM VISA ... Eligibility: Citizens of all countries ... Receive Visa certificate via email.

policies.title: DRC ordinary passports: Cuba electronic tourist visa
policies.summary: Cuba's current official tourism guidance requires a tourist visa for a non-resident Democratic Republic of the Congo visitor and makes the electronic tourist-visa route available from anywhere except the United States.
conditions: Use an ordinary passport issued by the Democratic Republic of the Congo MFA. Cuba names Chinese citizens as visa-exempt; a DRC ordinary-passport holder without Cuban residency must obtain the tourist visa.
Obtain the electronic tourist visa before travel; Cuba's D'Viajeros declaration is separate. The tourist visa is single-entry for up to 90 days, with a possible 90-day extension.
Work, residence, special passports, transit, carrier rules and final admission remain separate.

application.label: Cuban electronic tourist visa service
steps: Obtain the electronic tourist visa before departure using the DRC ordinary passport for travel.
Complete Cuba's separate D'Viajeros arrival declaration as required.
Comply with carrier and final-admission requirements.

policies.title: DRC ordinary passports: Côte d'Ivoire preapproved arrival visa
policies.summary: Côte d'Ivoire's current MFA guidance requires visitors to hold a visa, and its official ordinary-passport process gives online preapproval and prints/issues the visa at Abidjan airport.
conditions: Use a valid DRC ordinary passport. Complete SNEDAI pre-enrolment, payment and document upload; board only with the approved D.S.T. response, payment receipt, passport and yellow-fever certificate.
At Abidjan airport complete biometric enrolment; the visa is printed and issued there. This is online preapproval followed by border issuance, not an eVisa.
Work, residence, special passports, transit, carrier rules and final admission remain separate.

application.label: Côte d'Ivoire official visa pre-enrolment
steps: Submit the DRC ordinary-passport pre-enrolment and payment online, with the listed travel and hosting documents.
Wait for the D.S.T. approved response before boarding.
Complete biometric enrolment at Abidjan airport, where the visa is printed and issued.

policies.title: DRC ordinary passports: Nigeria tourism eVisa
policies.summary: Nigeria Immigration Service's current F5A tourism service makes an online, emailed tourism visa available to citizens of all countries.
conditions: Use a valid DRC ordinary passport and meet the current F5A tourism-document requirements.
Apply online, upload the required documents and pay the fee; receive the visa certificate by email before travel.
Work, residence, special passports, carrier rules and final admission remain separate.

application.label: Nigeria Immigration Service eVisa application
steps: Apply online using the DRC ordinary passport and upload the required tourism documents.
Pay the fee and obtain the visa certificate by email before travel.
Present the approved visa and supporting documents for carrier and final-admission checks.

conflicts.explanation: Côte d'Ivoire's current MFA guidance requires a visa, while the official ordinary-passport procedure requires approved online pre-enrolment and prints/issues the visa at Abidjan airport.
